ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Retailer acquisition, Account setup and later stages need Terms agreed and Account application received.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Retailer_acquisition", CASE(StageName, "Identified", 1, "Contacted", 2, "Line sheet sent", 3, "Range review", 4, "Terms discussion", 5, "Account setup", 6, "Account opened", 7, 0) >= 6, OR(NOT(Terms_agreed__c), NOT(Account_application_received__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Terms agreed and Account application received before moving to Account setup.
